files_touched.src-dotnet/Urman.Studio.Core/Play/PlayPr: campaign parameter + PackPathFor(selection); the old signature stays and delegates
files_touched.game/studio/StudioWorldSection.cs: Context/ApplyCampaignWorld with the write gate, zone and spawn for the preview and PlayStart, and refusals inside OnViewportInput, Place, SculptStroke, PaintStroke and ShowImport

addressed.P1 read-only was only a hint: a real gate: StudioRoot.WriteBlockReason freezes authoring, SetWriteBlock clears the selection and disables the AI button, OpenAiPanel refuses even if the button is re-enabled, and the world section refuses input, placement, sculpt, brush and import while the gate is set; the state is editor state and does not depend on the hint label
addressed.P2 full_game ignored the spawn arguments: the zone, spawn and point arguments are passed only for res://scenes/act1_demo.tscn, the scene whose root reads them
addressed.P2 the context could change during the c: the context is captured before await CompileAsync, so one campaign's pack cannot be paired with another world's scene
addressed.P2 the first Changed was lost before the: the selector's initial context is applied right after the sections are registered
addressed.P2 the read-only hint was hidden by Load: the gate lives in the root, so a preview reload, Apply or Undo cannot clear it
